jd.additional_context: This position may require occasional travel between the Burnaby, Surrey and Vancouver campuses to support on-site project delivery.
decision_making: The development and implementation of new project management frameworks.
The prioritization of projects within the designated portfolio.

duties.statement: Manages a portfolio of academic projects
Monitoring timelines and providing updates to senior administrators on the achievement of project goals and objectives.
Conducting cost-benefit analysis and research to develop solutions and make recommendations in support of decision-making.
Prioritizes and identifies current and future projects
Managing a strategic roadmap to highlight, track and identify projects within a designated portfolio.
Preparing reports and quantifying issues for senior leadership.

jd.position_summary: The Manager, Special Projects is a key resource, responsible for the identification, design and implementation of a designated portfolio of high-priority academic and co-curricular projects in support of the overall goals and objectives of the unit. The Manager provides leadership and support to advance organization-wide projects, ensuring the achievement of quality standards, timelines, deliverables and risk mitigation.
problem_solving: Conflicting demands for limited project resources across the portfolio.
Prioritization of workflow to meet inflexible reporting deadlines.

qualifications.text: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, or a relevant discipline and five years of related project experience, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
Excellent knowledge of project management methodologies and frameworks.
Advanced skills in MS Office including Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
Ability to exercise mature judgment, initiative, diplomacy and tact.

external: Represents the unit with external project-management associations and vendor partners.
internal: Works closely with faculties and administrative departments across all three campuses to advance projects.
relationships.supervisory: Establishes and maintains relationships and alliances. Maintains effective communication. Shares information and readily determines to whom to go for relevant information.

jd.title: Manager, Special Projects
